title: NILS pipeline proposals
description: Record 43 S6: the `proposals` member of a pipeline run's results.json, what a model says about the stacks it saw. The engine groups them into `<axis>:model` review items, one grouped question per axis, model, value and confidence band, and stages a decision by the model on each group at or above the task's threshold when the model is admitted or promoted and registered for the task `axis:<axis>`. Nothing is in force until a person commits it (record 42 R6). A group below the threshold is a review item only. The results schema of `contracts/job/v1` refers to this file for its `proposals` member; a results file with no proposals leaves the member out.

stack_id.description: The stack, by the id the run's stacks.json gave it

axis.description: An axis of the pack, such as body_part

value.description: The value proposed, one of the axis's values in the pack the model was built for, and one of the classes in probabilities

probabilities.description: The probability of every class the model weighed, by value; they sum to 1 within 0.01. The probability of the value is the proposal's confidence, and the whole map is kept as the member's evidence

model_id.description: The registered model that answered, by the id the run's model manifest gave it

model_digest.description: Or by its digest (contracts/model/v1), which the image can compute from the artifact it loaded. Given with model_id, the two name the same model

note.description: Words a person reads beside the numbers, such as a rule the image applied after the model. Never a name, a code or a date of a person
